claims.story_headline: Yen Nears 160 Per Dollar as Intervention Risk Mounts — Carry Trade Unwind Threatens

claims.capital_flow_implication: Carry trade unwind forces JPY shorts to cover → Nikkei selling → Asian EM FX re-pricing. The reflexivity of yen at 160 is the risk, not the level itself
